notes.title: Patch 3.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0df804e9fb4185b31633da4bf4a077095dc3dc4a.jpg
	SUMMARY:
[olist]			New community Marketplace is available. It will only be available in GD items. 				Reworked the character screens to have a more dynamic one. 				"Open World" has been renamed to ARCADE. Open World was a very vast term and Survival is also technically an Open World game mode. 				Some minor changes were made to the UI to make them look cleaner and better.				Fixed the competitive store. 				We have made a major change to vehicles that should fix the flying car issue that some of you would experience. 				Added High Precision Servers. They have a new netcode that should improve trading shots against high ping players. This is still being tested.				Spawn Protection now glows less at night and more during the day. That makes it harder for enemies to spot you when you spawn in. 				Added a "PVP Leaderboard" section to the Community Tab. It will contain Weekly, Monthly and Seasonal leaderboards only affected by PVP servers. 				Added a RESET SEASON button to the Season Pass. It will show up AFTER you finish the season and will allow you to start it again. 				Added a spawn protection when reviving in Battle Royale. 				And much more! Don't forget to watch the DevBlog. 	[/olist]	
		https://www.youtube.com/embed/YeTiMYTNYzA
	 

	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Open World has been renamed to Arcade.				Description of the different game modes has been changed.				We have reworked the character screen to a more dynamic one and they are unique to each game mode. 				Added a blur effect to the background when a new dialog pops up to make it easier to read.				ADDED A NEW TAB CALLED MARKET. IT'S AN OPEN MARKET WHERE PLAYERS CAN SELL AND BUY ITEMS DIRECTLY FROM OTHER PLAYERS. YOU CAN WATCH THE VIDEO ABOUT IT ABOVE!				Due to the addition of the MARKET, we have renamed the Marketplace to simply STORE.				Added a slider to the store to make it easier to switch amounts to buy.				Fixed the issue with the Competitive Store. It will now load properly.				Added a Notification system. For now, it will be used for the Market offers for the time being but it will be eventually implemented for everything else (server expiration, friend requests, subscription expiration, events, etc...)				Changed the default game background to a different renderer.				We are continuing to improve the scrolling on all screens.	
	GENERAL FIXES & CHANGES:
			The XP rewards on the PVE contracts has been increased from 1000 to 5000 each.				Medieval coins were removed from the inventories since the event is over.				Fixed a bug where deaths by traps and claymores wouldn't show properly on the death screen. 				"Ghost characters" do not show on the main menu Minimap anymore.				We have fixed the in-menu chat. It now should work properly. 				Fixed an issue where the player/zombie model would cause the vehicles to glitch through the ground and catapult them into space. 				Added a new server flag called High Precision Server. This is to address and test the new netcode to help bullet/hit registration. Fred goes into more details on it on the DevBlog. They will initially be activated on a few servers so we can see how it affects gameplay. As soon as we see it's as effective as hoped, they will be activated on all servers. 				Shooting Territory flags do not affect your KDR and rank anymore (they counted as missed shots).				Spawn Protection glow will change throughout the day (ingame time) to make it less "obvious". The darker it is, the less it will glow. This will help prevent people from spotting enemies as soon as they spawn at night.	
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	MODELS:
			Fixed a texture issue on the White House LODs.				Regenerated physics of all armors and backpacks, they should not fall through the ground anymore.				Regenerated all the icons of the G36 and its skinned versions.	
	SKINS:
			Fixes									All Sig Sauer 556 skins have a skinned iron sight.										Fixed an issue withe MP5 Tech Skin.						
	 

	 

	OPEN WORLD

	NEW FEATURES:
			Added a new Leaderboard called PVP Leaderboards (you can see a little bit of it on the DevBlog above). They will show weekly and monthly/seasonal leaderboards exclusively for the PVP servers. This will give us more room for exclusive PVP server events with leaderboards, without having it compete with Open World maps.				Remember to read above about the new MARKET, fully controlled by players. 	
	GENERAL FIXES:
			Fixed a visual bug where when placing a bounty on a player, your GD wouldn't always decrease as soon as you placed it. It still counted, but it wasn't shown. 				Fixed an issue that caused some zombie and players bodies to not disappear after being killed with a vehicle.				Added a Season Pass Restart button. You can now restart the Season Pass after completing it. 	
	 

	LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:
			Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.				Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 				Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.				Added new specialist contracts to the game, 5 PVP and 5 PVE ones.
			
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/95e9a5340b9c92bd3018dd576e7ceb2af6af971a.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0921d7f5c0fcf82ea71cd1bfcb8cd8976770c188.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/522508676daf690c50b1eb0750957d8325e595ad.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/27507c10d1ca7c3934c0389d1432db976bbc7267.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/bbc799bc0106345a0c5f2cffd1a9661ccc747ca8.png

	MAPS:
			COLORADO V1									Added more player spawns around Cottenwood.										Fixed the spawn cooldown for item boxes. Some of them were spawning too often.						
	 
			COLORADO									Fixed the spawn cooldown for item boxes. Some of them were spawning too often.						
	 
			TRADING LOUNGE									Medieval theme has been removed.										Summer theme has started.						
	 

	SURVIVAL

	GENERAL UPDATES

Optimized Zombie Networking:									When zombies are far away from players or are part of larger hordes, their networking is limited to decrease the bandwidth used by their movement packets. This change has lowered the zombie network usage by 70%.										This optimization fixes an issue where people with really bad connections suffered from ping spikes when farming the airport.										When zombies are close to you, this system does not apply (unless there are more than 50 of them in a big horde around you). notes.title: Medieval Event 2020
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/6abea7798ea69ef2e0dc784cf8dee22cafe310ab.png

	Dear players,

	It's FINALLY time to kick off an event we've been working on for the past 2-3 months! It is time to take New Z back to the Medieval days. This will be one of our bigger events and includes many exciting things like a NEW medieval map, many events, giveaways and competitions, medieval skins and much, much more!

	 

	Now, let's walk you through the details:

	EVENTS

	MEDIEVAL SEASONAL LEADERBOARD
			During the event, Medieval seasonal leaderboards will be active.				Top 5 in each leaderboard in Survival, OW and BR will be rewarded: 10 boxes for 1st place, 5 for 2nd, 3 for 3rd, 2 for 4th and 1 for 5th place.	
	Start: Friday, June 5, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Monday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)

	 

	PLAYTIME REWARD
			We will reward those who played 25 hours or more during the event with 5 medieval boxes.	
	Start: Friday, June 5, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Monday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)

	The boxes will be rewarded at the end of the event.

	 

	GLEAM GIVEAWAY

	We will give away LIFETIME PREMIUM and 5 medieval skinboxes to 3 lucky winners! The giveaway will be posted on June 9th on playnewz.com/giveaway.

	{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/40b5689e696701c2242d0389b86dfcf48991c1bd.jpg
	 

	Start: Tuesday, June 9, 12:00 PM (CET)
	End: Friday, June 22, 12:00 PM (CET)

	 

	DOUBLE GD/SD/BT/CT & XP

	We will run a Double Currency and Double XP event during the first week of the event! We want to give a heads up that Private servers may fill up quickly, but we have got an extra NA server to support the demand.

notes.title: Patch 3.5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26931738/0de2d627a718e42f1726c89b4887b69b1dfb1094.jpg

	SUMMARY:
[olist]			Fixed skins that didn't match the set.				Fixed abusable bugs related to vehicled and secret cave.				Fixed some minor UI issues and cleaned it up.				Added skins for the Medieval Event.				Fixed objects around the maps.				We are tweaking the loot from Helicopter Crashes, Slicers and Secret Rooms live from now on. Any feedback is welcome.				We made a small change to the gun switching system. It now prevents abuse from it.				Added new contracts/missions with Slicer body parts.				Fixed an issue related to multiple zombies. This issue most likely is the main cause of the ping spikes on areas with many zombies.				Improved loot in some areas in both Open World and Survival.				Changed the way loot spawns in Secret Locked Rooms.	[/olist]
	 

	Full Patch Notes:

	GENERAL CHANGES

	USER INTERFACES AND MENUS:
			Made some small UI changes to have a cleaner look.				Whenever you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if its a superior one than you had on.				Oceania Servers have been removed from the Server List.				Added a protection on changing weapons that was easily abused. 				Reverted back a change that would cause your mouse to "escape" the Window when you had other menus open.				Fixed a bug where players were able to open the ingame store while dead.				Fixed a bug where you could use your "Taunt" command while typing in search bars in the GI or store.				Updated the Tutorial Windows in English, German and Portuguese.				Fixed a few issues in the French translation.	

	GENERAL FIXES:
			Fixed an issue with zombies that caused gathering too many of them at the same time. This SHOULD fix the ping spikes, but we will need broader testing. 				Made a few changes to physics on cars versus players that allowed players to abuse and enter areas they shouldn't.				You can open the "player list" (Tab Menu) while climbing up and down stairs.				When you pick up gear and attachments from the vault, it will no longer auto equip if it's a better one than you had on.				Fixed an issue that caused an error when gifting a friend character clothes on the marketplace. 	
	 

	ITEM CHANGES

	VEHICLES:
			Fixed a visual bug that would show the wrong durability on vehicles.				You are no longer able to repair vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste repair kits. 				You are no longer able to refuel vehicles when they're at 100%, so you won't waste fuel.				Fixed an issue related to Player vs Vehicles physics that allowed players to glitch and abuse those glitches.				Normal Repair Kits will no longer repair vehicles with less than 25% durability left. For such cases a Premium Repair Kit will be required.	
	ZOMBIES:
			Improved textures and materials for the Slicer. This gives the Slicer a better appearance with more detail, especially on higher resolutions.				Added two new unique items to the Slicer: Slicer Head and Slicer Blades. They can be acquired from Slicers and are needed for the Razer Blade contracts. 	
	https://i.imgur.com/TTm8fg5.pnghttps://i.imgur.com/Rb6FtgM.png

	LOOT:

	https://i.imgur.com/o3tMajq.png
			Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 				Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	

	SKINS:
			Fixes									Fixed some K. Style NVG textures that didn't properly match the rest of their sets. Those include: Pulse, Black Night, Helix, Modern Black, Battle Royale, Crimson, Camo and Digital Red. 										Fixed some other Pulse skins. Their Glow Maps were not properly set and they now all have the same level of glow. 										Fixed the M107 Recipe icon. It was missing.										Renamed all the Sig Sauer 556 skins. They are now called Sig Sauer 556 "NAME". 										Fixed the Iron Sights on multiple Sig Sauer 556 skins. They were still using the unskinned version Iron Sight.										Fixed the AWP Tech glow map. Its glow was not properly set and it now matches the rest of the set. 										Fixed the coloring of the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Gold. It now matches the rest.										Fixed the colors and wings on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion.										Improved the Blue Night skins set. The colors have been readjusted to its intended colors. It's now less "purple" than it previously was. 										Fixed the description of the Sig Sauer 556 Skins.										Fixed an issue with the sound on the Valentine Heart Katana Skin.										Fixed the texture on the M9 NVG Valentine.										Fixed the model on the Heavy Armor Helix where the lower part of the armor would split from the rest when crouched. 							
		Additions									Added a new skin set for the Medieval Event. You will see more details on them when the event starts.										Added skins to be rewarded to Battle Royale 2019 Leaderboard Winners. These are 3 different skins. Rank 1 will receive a unique one, then ranks 2 to 10 will receive a different one and 11 to 50 will receive another one. These skins are unique and will be automatically applied on the accounts so therefore nobody else can get them.										Added two new Toxic Skins, the K. Style NVG and Moto Helmet. They will be added to the Revolution Skinbox.						
	 

	OPEN WORLD

	LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:
			Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.				Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 				Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.				New Contracts Added. They can be found around the world but they will also be in the Open World Contract Box.									Razor Blade I										Razor Blade II										Razor Blade III									Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 				Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	
	MAPS:
			COLORADO V1									Fixed a player spawn that had the player spawn inside a tree.										Moved some objects that were blocking the entrance of a few buildings.										Fixed some terrain issues at Blue Ridge Safe Zone.						
	 
			COLORADO									Fixed a Helicopter Crash at the Airport that contained the wrong loot pool. The loot from it now matches other Helicopters.						
	 
			OREGON									Fixed a airdrop spawn where the airdrop was going through a building while landing.						
	 

	SURVIVAL

	GENERAL:
			Fixed an issue where your backpack would change when you picked up a smaller backpack. It now only changes if you pick up a larger one.	

	LOOT & ITEM CHANGES:
			Items from Helicopter Crashes will continue to be tweaked over time.				Items from secret rooms will continue to be tweaked over time. 				Items from the Slicer and Toxic zombies will continue to be tweaked over time.				New Contracts Added. They can be found around the world but they will also be in the Survival Contract Box.									Razor Blade I										Razor Blade II										Razor Blade III									Items in secret rooms will now spawn in boxes. This will prevent these items from glitching through walls and always be visble. It will also avoid abusing items through walls. 				Added an extra protection against players camping inside secret rooms to wait for the loot to respawn.	

	MAPS:
			COLORADO V1									Fixed some misplaced objects at Norad Military Base.										Fixed a building at West Boulder that had a door blocked by some objects.						
	 
			COLORADO									Fixed a gap in Norad where players could get stuck.										Fixed a misplaced sandbag barricade at Camp Splinter.										Fixed some flying objects in Whitestone Mountain.										Buffed the military loot at the Airport.										Reworked the zombie spawns at the Airport because of server performances. The amount is still the same, but 30% of them will spawn over time.						
	 
			OREGON									Fixed an airdrop spawn where the airdrop would go through a building when landing.						
	 

	 

	Estimated patch size: 250MB

	Patch ETA: 1 Hour

	Estimated downtime: 1 Hour

	Pre-patch notes might be changed if we need to fix / add something.

	 

	Once again thank you for your great support! Want to support us even more? Make sure to share these updates with your friends and followers!

	For any feedback about the game please let us know at http://playnewz.com/feedback

	If you'd like to share suggestions and ideas you have for the game please let us know at https://suggest.playnewz.com/

	To stay updated regarding the patch and server downtime please follow us on our social media:
	Facebook:https://www.facebook.com/Infestation.NewZ/

	Twitter: https://twitter.com/infestationnewz

	Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/thenewz

	Youtube: http://www.youtube.com/c/InfestationTheNewZOfficial

	Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/infestationthenewz

	Website: http://playnewz.com/

	Forums: https://forums.fredaikis.com/

	 

	 

	Best Regards,

	 

	// Fredaikis Team

notes.title: Patch 3.4
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/dKnBTGD.jpg

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/9023-patch-34/)

	As planned we are releasing patch 3.4 including fixes and improvements and the new Season Pass 04. Next to that we are also releasing the new Pulse skin collection. We are working hard on the next upcoming event although it's not just ready yet. Expect more information about that soon.

	 

	Now, without further ado, let's jump in to the patch notes:

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Various new assets have been added to the game related to a future medieval themed event. More information about the Medieval 2020 event will follow soon.				Fixed an issue related to the recently added prefab spawn system. This is the system that for example controls the random appearing helicopter crashes on the maps. There was an issue that could cause the site not to spawn on private servers.				Fixed a bug that caused players not being able to pick up particular items in secrets rooms.	
	VEHICLES:
			Improved / Updated textures for the racer vehicle.				Fixed a bug causing cars to de-sync with clients.				You can no longer exit a vehicle while trying to glitch inside a locked area. People were using cars to glitch inside these rooms / areas. We'd like to remind all of you here that we have systems in place to ban players attempting this. Don't do it.	
	3D MODELS:
			Upscaled textures for the airfield control tower.	
	SPAWN SYSTEM:
			We are working hard on the current spawn system in the game. We have heared your feedback and made according improvements: players will no longer always spawn in the exact location of the player spawn, but instead  spawn in a close area around that particular spawn. This will always be random. We hope aim to improve the current situation.	
	 

	Medieval 2020 Event:

	The Medieval 2020 event will not start just yet, so hold on! With this update we are already teasing some of the content for you guys.
			The vault NPC textures have been updated to fit the Medieval 2020 event style.				The trading lounge has been updated to the Medieval 2020 variant.	
	We hope you are all as excited for this event as we are. Stay tuned for more soon!

	https://i.imgur.com/zkiJwJt.png

	https://i.imgur.com/7ixzRAB.png

	(More pictures here: https://imgur.com/a/w49ITgz)

	 

	Season Pass 04:

	In this update we are releasing Season Pass 04. The pass will directly be available after the update in the in-game marketplace for 2000 GC. A lot of new, unique content has been created and added to the game for this Season Pass and overall we are very happy with the result.
	
	https://i.imgur.com/RtfgG8i.jpg

	Based on your feedback we have created Season Pass 04 and there is a couple of things that we'd like to address and explain:
[olist]			This Season Pass will be available and over a period of time that is over 2 months. It will end on July 31, at 12:00 PM (CET) 2020. The reason for this length is so that everyone has enough time to potentially finish it and claim all the rewards from all the levels.
		 				The levels and XP needed per level hasn't changed compared to previous passes. We are overall pretty satisfied with the current level and XP amounts so there is not really a reason (yet) to change anything around this subject.
		 				New exclusive content has been added for the Season Pass 04. This goes from unique sprays and taunts all the way to skins. A lot of next-level looking skins have been added and will only be available through the season pass. (Screenshot below of the new "SVD Hell" skin that you'll only be able to get through Season Pass 04:)
	
		And no, this is not the ONLY unique skin / content for the Season Pass 04. There is a lot more!
		
		https://i.imgur.com/2mesrh7.png
		
		 				There is also a dedicated key item (both for Survival and Open World) available in Season Pass 04. In this case, players can get the Season Pass 04 Key 7x for each Survival and Open World through the rewards.
		
		Players can use these keys to enter an exclusive Season Pass 04 zone that can only be entered by players with this particular key. In these areas players have a chance to find even more exclusive Season 04 Pass-only content. And yes, even have a chance on getting ANOTHER SVD Hell skin recipe.
		
		Risky? Yes. You'll have to venture through Colorado V2 and open the door, although since this is map based, you can also just go on your private server.
		Remember, you'll only receive 7 keys in total for both Survival and Open World each. You'll only have 7 tries as they key disappears from your inventory once the door is opens.
		
		Where are these "areas"? Well, they are caves actually. They are only on the Colorado V2 map for both Survival and Open World and there is only 1 on each map. You'll have to find the location yourself. Good luck!
		
		https://i.imgur.com/4AFnvSy.jpg
		
		https://i.imgur.com/SDRRMig.png	[/olist]
	 

	Item & Skin Updates:

	REWORKS:
			Reworked the store icon for NVG Goggles Civilian.	
	ADDITIONS:
			Added a new skinbox: Pulse Skinbox.
		https://i.imgur.com/LrVBokZ.png				Added a new skin for the Custom Guerilla: Custom Guerilla Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.
		https://i.imgur.com/06Gf9et.png				Added a new skin for the Heavy Armor: Heavy Armor Pulse. This skin is part of the Pulse skin collection and content of the Pulse Skinbox.

			Private servers will no longer have a group / clan limit in Survival.

notes.title: Patch 3.2
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/qeNP9ER.jpg

	Dear Community,

(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8930-patch-32/)

	It's time for another update and this time a lot more aimed towards beginning players where we have added tutorial screens, more translations and more language support over all. Next to all of this we are patching in the new "Tech" skins with the Tech Skinbox. We are also rolling out this update to patch in content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. More information about that event will be released in the near future.

	 

	For now, let's get in to the patch notes.

	 

	Overall Updates:

	GENERAL:
			Added various new content for the upcoming Easter 2020 event. Easter secret spots have been added to all maps. Please note that once again these spots are already showing in the game but won't be spawning any loot until the Easter 2020 event starts.				All the beginner missions that activate when joining the beginner training map are now translated in all available languages.				The in-game chat font has been updated to a different one that supports more languages including Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai and more. There will no longer be weird block icons showing when using characters from a specific language. If you still experience issues with writing your language in the in-game chat please let us know so we can work on this.				The character name allowance has been improved as well. We now allow characters to be created again with a lot more characters and letters from specific languages.				The Steam friends system is now integrated in to the game. This means you can now see and invite any of your Steam friends from the game to come and play with you.				Added a tutorial slideshow for new players. This screen can be accessed by pressing F1 in either the main menu or in-game. There is separate screens for the different game-modes and there is separate screens for in the menu and in the game. We have also localized these screens although we are not 100% finished with the translations and all the screens yet. More will be added in future updates.	
	GAMEPLAY:
			Added an option to enable / disable the automatic equip of gear and attachments when picked up or attached.				Picking up a better helmet will no longer automatically switch the gas mask when a player is inside the radiation zone or when a night vision is enabled.	
	SERVERS:
			Support for Oceania servers has been added. This means this is now a new region added in the game. There is no servers running in this new region just yet but there will be a later specific announcement about this.	
	 

	Item & Skin Updates:

	UPDATES:
			Updated all Custom Guerilla Fallen Angel skins. We have reworked the wings just like we did on the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel skins. The wings look better, are in a better position and are more optimized.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Police Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Halloween 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Summer 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Valentine 2020 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the skinbox icon for the Winter 2019 Box. This box is legacy but the icon was never updated.				Updated the store icon and the recipe icon for the QBZ-95 Tech skin. This skin will also be added to the new Tech Skinbox.	
	FIXES:
			Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Chrome texture. The skin should now be properly chrome again.				Fixed the Heavy Armor BR Champion. It is now better rigged around the character and should fit any character better.				Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Purple skin. The wings are now chrome again instead of white glowing.				Fixed the Heavy Armor Fallen Angel Desion skin. The wings are now chrome red-ish again instead of white glowing.				Rank skins now also apply to Battle Royale team wins.	
	REWORKS:
			Reworked the store icon for the VSS Vintorez (sniper) & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the VSS Compact & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Honey Badger & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the QLB & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the SVU & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Flashlight & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Hatchet & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Blaser & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the AWP & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the Bizon & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the P90 & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the MP5/10 SD & it's skinned variants.				Reworked the store icon for the B93r & it's skinned variants.	
	FURTHER WEAPON STATS REWORK:
	Continuing the guns rework, we have revisited prior changes we've made to SMGs and readjusted them to better serve their real purposes. 
	SMGs are made to be extremely powerful close combat weapons and they should not be strong at a high distance. The issue with their previous status is that, first of all, they had no pattern... Some were extremely strong at certain distances, while others were useless even at close range. Now, we've adjusted to make them at least a bit more logically similar (but not the same) as they all serve the same purpose. 
	Basically, we have adjusted damage, improved speed and spread while nerfing the damage distance on them. We also took into consideration each gun's fire-rate and clip size to make this fair. That way, they will adapt to your play style better and you will be inclined to use each one, depending on how you like playing (rushing and pre-firing, tap-shooting, waiting-and-shooting, spray-and-spray, etc...). 

	LMGs needed a rework as well, however this is very delicate. LMGs's current main purpose and use is for farming, especially for killing super/alien zombies so we had to tread carefully here. 
[olist]			We cannot lower their damage or it will affect their current main use, which we don't want to hinder. 				We also can't make it too precise as they are extremely powerful for automatic weapons, with very high damage. 				We shouldn't leave them stuck only for extremely close combat. 	[/olist]
	So with these three things in mind, we have added the Spread Variation System to it, where the more you shoot the more spread it has, with a fair limit to it, so it also doesn't go to the sky. 

	Future tweaks may occur on these weapons in the near future, but for now, enjoy their new stats and try them out!

	ADDITIONS:
			Added a new healing item: Toilet Paper. This item won't be available straight away but will be part of a future upcoming event. The toilet paper works just like a bandage, it has animations and can heal the player when being used.

			Improved the Battle Royale matchmaking system for faster games aka less queue time.				Reworked the Battle Royale queue UI screen. notes.title: Infestation: Battle Royale - OUT NOW
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/RnWnALV.jpg

	Dear Community,


(Original Post: https://forums.fredaikis.com/index.php?/topic/8876-infestation-battle-royale-out-now/)


	We are proud to announce that Infestation: Battle Royale is now officially released and available to everyone on Steam.

	We would also like to take this moment to thank all of those who have supported us along the way.

	 

	You can play Infestation: Battle Royale in 2 ways:
			Through Steam at: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1240290/Infestation_Battle_Royale/
		
		or
		 				Through our Launcher which you can download at: http://playnewz.com/download	
	 

	For those with more further questions we have listed out an FAQ below:
			What will happen to the current Battle Royale mode that is already available in Infestation: The New Z?
		What started out as a beta has now grown so big that we decided it's time to make Battle Royale its own game. BR will be lifted out of New Z before the release and added to the launcher and Steam as a separate game. By doing so we hope to raise the attention of new players, and also players who are into Battle Royale games but not necessarily survival.  For the patch set for early March/late February we are bringing a lot of new content both to The New Z and Battle Royale such as Colorado V1 BR, massive vehicle improvements, performance optimizations, 64-bit gameplay, new loot with new spawn mechanisms etc.
		 				Can I still use my New Z Account? What will happen to my purchased content?
		Don't worry, you will still use the same account in order to log in. You will not lose anything from the splitting, all skins, sprays and other content which you've purchased in New Z will still be available in the new Battle Royale game.
		 				OK, so the accounts will be linked?
		Correct, things like experience, season passes, account subscriptions will still be synced over both games, just like before. If you make a purchase in Infestation: Battle Royale it will be available in The New Z and vice versa.
		 				What will happen to the older Battle Royale leaderboards from New Z?
		As this in a way means that Battle Royale is stepping out of Beta, hopefully with a great influx of new players - we feel that it makes sense to also reset the current leaderboards. This will be done on the Steam launch date - 4th of March - and high ranked players will be contacted and granted a special reward.
		 				I don't play Battle Royale, how is this beneficial for me?
		Our hope is that this will as well raise the public's attention to New Z and that it will help bring an influx of players to both games!
		 				What about New Z? Will it be left behind?
		NO! Together with the BR separation we are patching The New Z into patch 3.0! With the 64-bit additions and focus on performance improvements and bugs lately we think it's time for New Z to step into the next stage and we aim to bring you updates just like we have been for the past 4 years!  More info about patch 3.0 will come at a later stage!	
	 

	Also, our community manager @ElChupacabra will be live streaming the release. You can tune in here: https://www.twitch.tv/hereschupa/ If you want to see more streamers streaming Infestation: Battle Royale tune in at: https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Infestation%3A Battle Royale

	 

	We are also doing a life time premium account upgrade giveaway for 3 random people. You can join the giveaway here: https://www.playnewz.com/giveaway.php
